timeline.summary: India Ratings upgraded Syrma SGS's long-term bank loan facilities to IND AA/Stable and affirmed commercial paper at IND A1+ on May 5, 2026.
Syrma SGS reported Q4FY26 standalone revenue of ₹1,220.7 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹1.50 per share.
Syrma SGS reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,477 Cr (up 56% YoY) and full-year FY26 revenue of ₹4,819 Cr (up 27% YoY) on May 11, 2026.
Syrma SGS and Premier Energies terminated the proposed acquisition of a 49% stake in Ksolare Energy due to unfulfilled conditions precedent.
Syrma SGS Technology Limited uploaded the audio recording of its conference call for audited financial results (Q4FY26 & FY26) on May 12, 2026, via its website.
Syrma SGS reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,857 Cr and operating EBITDA of ₹545 Cr, guiding for 30-35% growth in FY27.
Syrma SGS reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,819 Cr (up 27% YoY) and PAT of ₹345.8 Cr (up 87% YoY).
Syrma SGS Q1FY27 revenue rose 67% YoY to ₹1,604 Cr with PAT up 112% to ₹106 Cr; order book ₹6,770 Cr and PCB commercial production guided for April 2027.
Syrma SGS scheduled its Q2FY27 earnings conference call for November 2, 2026.
